main_text.l: PRÆLECTIO SECUNDA
In quâ ostenditur, non esse in Bonæ
Intentionis conscientiâ satis præ-
sidii, ut in eâ possit aliquis tutò
acquiescere.
ROM. III. 8.

l.i: Et non sicut blasphemamur, & sicut quidam
aiunt nos dicere, Faciamus mala, ut eve-
niant bona : quorum damnatio justa est.

page.notes: The title line "In quâ ostenditur..." is set larger than the text and is treated as a heading. The running head is faint; its reading "De Bona Intentione" is uncertain. The verse is printed in italic throughout. Right margin notes, in order: "¹ Horat."; "² Satyr. 2."; "³ Epist."; "Menti ades in Capitolio, vid. Cic. 2 de nat. Deor. & Liv. lib. 23."; "⁴ Plutarch. in quaest. Platon."; "⁵ Ovid. Fast."; "⁶ Senec." These are set beside the lines of the text and are shown here by their marks as far as they can be read. The marks on the Greek lines and the mark placed before "Mentem" are not clear enough to be certain. The handwritten word at the foot right ("hos.") is not printed and is left out. The Greek on line 1 and in the foot line is only approximately read.
